notes: Epoch AI per-model pages re-read 2026-10-07 by direct curl; the scorecard table of each page is parsed and only that model's own column is stored (the same page also shows 3 comparison models). Pages now render server-side, so the 2026-09-22 note that they needed a headless browser no longer applies. Newly available: Claude Opus 5.5 (404 on 2026-09-22), GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6 Luna (404 then), Sonnet 5.5 and GPT-6.1 Sol. Metrics without a catalog metric id (Furniture Assembly, WeirdML v3, Vending-Bench, ProofBench, CritPt, SciCode (Epoch), APEX-Agents, Blueprint-Bench, FrontierSWE v2, Text Arena Coding on Epoch's own scale) are not stored. Epoch revised Astra's ECI from 167 (2026-09-22) to 166.

claims.statement: Epoch Capabilities Index 2026-10-07 (257 tracked models): Claude Opus 5.5 167 (#1), GPT-6 Astra 166 (#2; it was 167 and #1 of 251 on the 2026-09-22 read), GPT-6.1 Sol 166 (#3), Claude Sonnet 5.5 165 (#4), Claude Fable 5.1 165 (#5), Claude Opus 5 163, GPT-6 Sol 163 (#7), GPT-6 Luna 156 (#24), GLM-5.3 156 (#27), Grok 4.7 154 (#41), Kimi K3 157 (#15). Epoch shows no per-effort breakdown.

Epoch own-run scorecard for GPT-6.1 Sol: Chess Puzzles 61%, EBR-bench 54%, Mystery Game Puzzles 80%, FrontierMath Tier 1-3 (v2) 94%, Tier 4 (v2) 100%, OTIS Mock AIME 100%, Furniture Assembly 80% (no catalog metric), GPQA Diamond 95%, SimpleQA Verified 74%; page release date September 29, 2026.

Gemini 4 Argon has an Epoch page (released Sep. 30, 2026) with Vending-Bench 2 $13,718, APEX-Agents 88%, ProofBench 99%, Blueprint-Bench 2 54%, CritPt 27%, SciCode 62%, Text Arena (Coding) 1680, FrontierSWE (v2) 55% but no ECI yet; Step 5 Preview's page (Sep. 18, 2026) shows ProofBench 42%, CritPt 21%, SciCode 59%, Text Arena (Coding) 1570 and no ECI. Neither is a stored catalog row for Argon; Step 5's rows use metrics without catalog ids and are not stored.
